limits: Fresh installation requires manual Options > Playback > Output > Video Mixing Renderer 9 (renderless). Default renderer fails to load; its basic EVR fallback plays but two PNG Save Image attempts left the requested file absent. This recipe does not automatically configure VMR9.

VMR9 limited GUI workflow: open Chinese-name 20.041667-second MPEG4/MP3 AVI, visibly play, pause/seek, save one PNG, normal exit and fresh managed process reopen the PNG. PNG is 640x360 and matches candidate source frame 479 within mean absolute RGB error 0.8824 / maximum 3, among the final ten decoded candidates; this is not verification of all frames.

Known unresolved timing problem: UI displayed 00:40 / 00:20 near the end of the source. Correct playback timing, automatic end-of-file, A/V synchronization and precise seeking are not accepted. This is not proven to be merely a display defect.

PNG reopen proves file persistence and a fresh image-open workflow; it does not prove video renderer persistence or video replay across processes. No hardware audio observation, subtitles, hardware acceleration, HDR, streaming or network playback acceptance.

Official fixed installer digest matches GitHub release asset digest; GUI version/commit and installed COPYING match fixed source. Complete bundled source/license closure, Authenticode and reproducible build are not verified.

Signed catalogue activation, independent market installation generation, update/rollback and service restart remain pending at receipt freeze. Fresh-machine unattended registration, guest online download and cross-version upgrades are not verified.

This final publication adds independent market-generation visible replay, pause/seek, frame PNG verification, normal exit, fresh video replay with GUI-observed persisted VMR9, PNG reopen, exact original-generation rollback/PNG reopen, full Core/Store restart and forward corrected-proof activation. These later checks supersede only the frozen receipt statements that market lifecycle and renderer persistence were still pending.
